request.state:
Subject: Put some jazz into your mid-semester break

While most students at the Albany campus are enjoying a mid-semester
break, the Jazz Studies students are still here and working hard. Why?
Because they follow the NZ School of Music schedule and they will take
their break later this month (eg, no jazz on 15 and 22 April).

Accordingly, there will be jazz performance workshops tomorrow (Tuesday)
beginning at 5pm in the Staff Lounge of the Study Centre. 

Come on..... Make plans to be there...... You deserve a break too.

See you there,

Dennis
